en.answer: Even in this case, a "Ritual Beast" card is banished normally, and will be added to the hand during the second Standby Phase afterward.
en.question: If the effect of <<11497>> is activated, but during the resolution it is no longer face-up on the field, how will the effect resolve?
en.title: If the effect of <<11497>> is activated, but during the resolution it is no longer face-up on the field, how will the effect resolve?

ja.answer:
質問の状況の場合でも、『デッキから「霊獣」カード１枚を除外する』処理は通常通り適用されます。
また、『発動後２回目の自分スタンバイフェイズに、この効果で除外したカードを手札に加える』処理も通常通り適用されます。
